title: The Dragon issue-26 opener part two: the table round (census 886)

banner.title: The Dragon issue-26 opener part two - the table round
banner.provenance: The part-two round of the issue-26 four-round shape - four of the thirteen Curtiss-called chains pinned as the table round: the Chinese Undead roster (print 20-21) with the six undead brackets, the nine-point alignment chart (print 23) with the conduct encodings, the Deck of Fate tarot artifact (print 24-25) with the wheel bands and the arcana, and the strength comparison ladder (print 38) with the giant rungs and the ogre power revision, the five-chain opener set down at part one and the four-chain commentary set plus the flip to follow. All pinned from The Dragon Vol. III No. 12 (June 1979) print 20-25 and 38 at extract/dragon/026 (landed at R962), the single-voice transcript of the Curtiss-provided scan; the four grids carry the printed numbers as scanned, the strength ladder printing its overlapping 18/90 row pinned as scanned. The watches - the Sullin levels 7-9 and the brawling sequel - ride to TD 27 absent a fifth issue.
